description: This file contains unit tests for the PcbNode parsing and related PCB modules, including tests for parsing PCB nodes, modules, segments, and connectivity checks.

classes.name: PcbNodeTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing PCB node parsing, module parsing, segment connectivity, and related functionalities.

methods.name: testParser
methods.description: Tests the parsing of basic PCB nodes and their packing functionality.

methods.name: testParseModule
methods.description: Tests parsing of a PCB module node and retrieval of its reference.

methods.name: testConnected
methods.description: Tests the connectivity detection between modules and segments in PCB layout.

methods.name: testSegmentConnected
methods.description: Tests the connection logic between segments in the PCB layout.

methods.name: testSegmentConnected2
methods.description: Tests module connection logic with more complex segment and module arrangements.
